description: The Directorate General of Health Services of Bangladesh runs a public health information dashboard from its Management Information System, built on the DHIS2 health information platform with support from HISP Bangladesh. The dashboard read on 2026-09-28 links modules for routine live health data, the health facility registry, the health workforce and biometric attendance, asset and logistics management, local health bulletins, the health emergency operation centre and control room, and COVID-19. Its front page shows last-twelve-month figures from facility reporting, such as about 34.8 million outpatient visits, deliveries in public facilities, maternal and neonatal deaths and antenatal counselling, and charts with tables of national indicators from household surveys since 1993, including child mortality, fertility, vaccination coverage and child nutrition. Coverage is Bangladesh, nationally and by administrative unit in the routine data. Access to the dashboard is free; no licence or export option was read. Caveats: most figures sit in interactive dashboards, and the facility registry and logistics modules were not opened. It supports health service capacity and emergency studies, such as comparing outpatient load across districts with facility counts before planning cyclone or flood response. No related Bangladesh health record is catalogued.
